wish: someone should make a music player where sound quality improves with your jogging speed
spec: Plays a demo loop or a song from your device through a low-pass filter. Your step rate from the motion sensor, or set by hand or by tapping, opens the filter from muffled at 60 steps/min to full quality at 180. It does not stream music, read your music library, or work without a tap to start.
notes: Offline. Motion cadence needs a phone with a motion sensor; buttons and step tapping are the fallback.
